title: VoxelCore
description: Did you ever want more realistic models in game but didn't want to loose that voxel like aesthetic? Look no further!
body:
# VoxelCore - 1.1.0
Elevate your Minecraft experience with enchanced 3D models for blocks!
This pack features enchanced 3D models for blocks adding physical depth.

---
### Texture Pack Compatibility-
This is compatible with any texture pack of any resolution, however this was designed with the looks of the default Minecraft textures kept in mind. Certain blocks may look off with certain texture packs

NOTE: Please use the [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium) mod for models to appear properly!

### Changelog:
- Added model for Dark Oak Doors

### Development Status:
This resource pack is WIP, many blocks are yet to have their own 3D models and some arent fully polished. For a list of blocks added till now, please refer below:

<details>
<summary>Supported Blocks</summary>
  
- Wood varients
- Log varients
- Stripped wood & log varients
- Noteblocks
- Copper Bulb varients
- Dispenser (vertical)
- Dark Oak Door

</details>

<details>
<summary>Upcomming!</summary>
  
- Cherry Door (Top Priority)
- Spruce Door
- Bamboo Door

</details>

<details>
<summary>Changelog</summary>
  
- Spruce Door (Bottom)
- Birch Door (Bottom)

</details>

### Note:
- Put this pack above any other packs for best compatibility.
- This pack may have slight performance issues on low end devices
- Dependent on [Sodium](https://modrinth.com/mod/sodium)

### Issues:
A known issue is block faces covered by a block having a custom model appear to be invisible. A temporary fix has been applied for dirt and grass.
